name: CategoryTheory.Cat.bicategory.strict
initialProofState: ⊢ CategoryTheory.Bicategory.Strict CategoryTheory.Cat
decl:
/-- `Cat` is a strict bicategory. -/
instance bicategory.strict : Bicategory.Strict Cat.{v, u} where
  id_comp {C} {D} F := by cases F; rfl
  comp_id {C} {D} F := by cases F; rfl
  assoc := by intros; rfl

name: CategoryTheory.typeToCat_map
initialProofState:
X Y : Type u
f : Quiver.Hom X Y
⊢ Eq (CategoryTheory.typeToCat.map f) (id (CategoryTheory.Discrete.functor (Function.comp CategoryTheory.Discrete.mk f)))
decl:
/-- Embedding `Type` into `Cat` as discrete categories.

This ought to be modelled as a 2-functor!
-/
@[simps]
def typeToCat : Type u ⥤ Cat where
  obj X := Cat.of (Discrete X)
  map := fun {X} {Y} f => by
    dsimp
    exact Discrete.functor (Discrete.mk ∘ f)
  map_id X := by
    apply Functor.ext
    · intro X Y f
      cases f
      simp only [id_eq, eqToHom_refl, Cat.id_map, Category.comp_id, Category.id_comp]
      apply ULift.ext
      aesop_cat
    · aesop_cat
  map_comp f g := by apply Functor.ext; aesop_cat

name: CategoryTheory.instFaithfulCatTypeToCat
initialProofState: ⊢ CategoryTheory.typeToCat.Faithful
decl:
instance : Functor.Faithful typeToCat.{u} where
  map_injective {_X} {_Y} _f _g h :=
    funext fun x => congr_arg Discrete.as (Functor.congr_obj h ⟨x⟩)

name: CategoryTheory.instFullCatTypeToCat
initialProofState: ⊢ CategoryTheory.typeToCat.Full
decl:
instance : Functor.Full typeToCat.{u} where
  map_surjective F := ⟨Discrete.as ∘ F.obj ∘ Discrete.mk, by
    apply Functor.ext
    · intro x y f
      dsimp
      apply ULift.ext
      aesop_cat
    · rintro ⟨x⟩
      apply Discrete.ext
      rfl⟩
